claims.text: The program offers major grants of £100,000 and over.
Applicants submit a Major Grant Expression of Interest Form via the Grants Management Portal.
Applicants receive bespoke guidance within 10 working days.
Applicants may be invited for a call if potentially suitable.
Local community capital projects (e.g. churches, village halls) are advised to apply for a regular grant instead.
The total cost of what is being applied for must be at least £1 million for a major grant.
For core costs, an organization's annual income must be £1 million or over to be eligible for a major grant.
For capital or project costs, the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million to be eligible for a major grant, regardless of the organization's income.
Grants for local community capital projects are typically up to a maximum of £30,000.
